title: Progressive Disclosure Release Skill
domain: Evidence-backed customer release notes from arbitrary Git ranges
mission: Replace a broad monolithic prompt with a focused, portable release-notes skill that loads resources conditionally.
outcome: The packaged skill improves release-note accuracy while using only the policy and deterministic tooling needed by each request.
seededDefects: all rules and examples load for every task
missing artifacts are treated as passing
verificationGates: npm run verify:exercise checks protected inputs, implementation quality, and required submission evidence.
agentWorkflow: separate core workflow from conditional policy
replace copied Git output with one reusable script
run a fresh skill attempt and selective scenarios
Capture comparable before and after results using the conditions defined in the exercise README.
masterySignals: customer output is traced and evidence-safe
